texts: Why does the village cremate the dead?

fields.sentence: Why does the village cremate the dead?

q2_gaps: substantivized adjective as a definite plural nominal ('the dead') — the instruction set gives no rule for an adjective-headed NP, and its definite-plural rule (group witness) and its bare-kind-filler licence for non-specific objects pull in opposite directions here
review.notes: Explanation-question shape (focus pattern + ReasonFor, one line), cremate -> Patient, the definite subject bound by its kind, and the unmarked habitual (no tense atom) all follow the instruction set. Only the encoding of the object NP is left unsettled by the doctrine.
